name: dev-flow
description: Development task flow: dev-task-flow skill that runs an implementation task (feature, improvement, refactoring) from a short brief through sizing, goal exploration, delegation and design consultation, implementation, verification, self-review, PR, and final report. Delegates each step to its owning skill (goal-exploration, model-effort-guide, self-review, pr-split, etc.). Includes a Claude Code PreToolUse hook that, in sessions that opened dev-task-flow, blocks gh pr create / gh pr ready / worker_done until self-review covers the last code change and stacked branches include their lower steps.
